_why: Connector and courtesy words the model may use in the one sentence it writes above a numbered list. Every OTHER word in that sentence must already appear in the visitor's question or in the list itself. This file therefore decides what a fabricated sentence CANNOT be built from, so it carries no negation word and no evaluative word: with 'not' in here, 'this company is not active in this field' would be legal (every other token comes from the list), and with 'best' in here, 'company X is the best choice' would be. Language-level, not category-level: it ships once and does not change per customer. A test pins the ban list.
